DDL	CREATE TABLE t1(col1 INT, col2 STRING)
DDL	CREATE TABLE t2(col1 INT, col2 STRING)
READ	SELECT * FROM t2 as t2_1 LEFT JOIN t2 as t2_2 ON t2_1.col1 = t2_2.col1
READ	SELECT * FROM t2 as t2_1 RIGHT JOIN t2 as t2_2 ON t2_1.col1 = t2_2.col1
READ	SELECT * FROM t2 as t2_1 CROSS JOIN t2 as t2_2 ON t2_1.col1 = t2_2.col1
READ	SELECT * FROM t2 as t2_1 INNER JOIN t2 as t2_2 ON t2_1.col1 = t2_2.col1
READ	SELECT col2 AS alias FROM t1 as t1_1 LEFT ANTI JOIN t1 as t1_2 ON t1_1.col1 = t1_2.col1 ORDER BY col2
READ	SELECT col2 AS alias FROM t1 as t1_1 LEFT SEMI JOIN t1 as t1_2 ON t1_1.col1 = t1_2.col1 ORDER BY col2
READ	SELECT col1 FROM t1 as t1_1 LEFT SEMI JOIN t1 as t1_2 ORDER BY col2
READ	SELECT col1 FROM t1 as t1_1 LEFT SEMI JOIN t1 as t1_2 GROUP BY ALL HAVING MIN(col2) > 1
READ	SELECT 1 FROM t2 NATURAL JOIN t1 JOIN t2 ON t2.col1 = t1.col1 WHERE t2.col2 = 1
READ	SELECT 1 FROM t2 NATURAL JOIN t1 JOIN t2 ON t2.col1 = t1.col1 GROUP BY t2.col2 HAVING t2.col2 = 1
READ	SELECT 1 FROM t2 NATURAL JOIN t1 JOIN t2 ON t2.col1 = t1.col1 ORDER BY t2.col2
DDL	DROP TABLE t1
DDL	DROP TABLE t2
